listen.en: I love to listen to music in the evening.

listener.en: My friend is a great listener.
listener.cn: 我的朋友是个很好的倾听者。

listener.en: A good listener never breaks in when others speak.
listener.cn: 好的倾听者从不打断别人说话。

hear.en: Do you hear the bird singing?
I can hear the rain on the window at night.
hear.cn: 夜里我能听到雨打窗户的声音。

ear.en: We have two ears to listen.
Cover your ears when the noise is too loud.
ear.cn: 噪音太大时请捂住耳朵。

quiet.en: Please keep quiet when the teacher is talking.
quiet.cn: 老师讲话时请保持安静。

good.en: It is good to listen carefully in class.

careful.en: Please be careful with the glass.
A careful listener can hear every word.
careful.cn: 仔细的听众能听清每一个词。

please.en: Please listen to me first, then ask questions.
